what: Panel post-processing still reads original manifest outputs instead of waterfall-resolved output paths
scenario_or_breakage: When Cursor returns narration-only OK and Codex phase 2 produces a valid ## Recommendation, dispatch-with-waterfall will report the phase2 path, but the panel loop greps the original Cursor path and marks the slot unparsed or missing; usable counts and aggregator inputs stay wrong
suggested_fix: Read ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH in slot order and pair it with manifest rows; also capture ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS so vendor reflects the actual fallback tool. Add a panel test where original outputs fail but paths-file phase2 outputs pass

what: Plan pattern-gates STATUS=cap_hit and routes it into fallback
scenario_or_breakage: cap_hit is the token-budget skip sentinel from launch-review.sh; requiring ## Recommendation means every cap-hit output misses the regex, then tries the alternate tool and finally Claude, bypassing the intended budget stop
suggested_fix: Treat cap_hit as terminal before the regex gate, or make the gate apply only to STATUS=OK. Add a regression test proving --require-result-pattern does not launch phase2 or phase3 for cap_hit

what: Invalid ERE handling in the plan is internally inconsistent
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says invalid regexes error out, but the proposed if grep ... else failed path treats grep exit 2 the same as no match, silently falling through all phases and ending as ordinary reviewer failure
suggested_fix: Distinguish grep rc 1 from rc >1, or prevalidate REQUIRE_RESULT_PATTERN once against /dev/null and exit 2 with larch_err on syntax errors
